schedule_basis: Dependencies + person-hours/(crew x 40 h/week) + per-phase waits + 2-4 week project buffer; independent trade crews assumed, not resource-leveled. Owner phase capacity uses combined 40 h/week and effort multiplier 1.35. Timeline starts after approved design/permit, delivered long-lead packages and site mobilization; stops at house closeout. Off-house water/wastewater availability can still delay occupancy.
